user.title: Select your indoor unit type
user.description: Only indoor humidity and noise are exposed. Use your own Netatmo developer application credentials.

device.title: Select an indoor unit
device.description: Polling defaults to 60 seconds. Actual measurement freshness depends on Netatmo cloud uploads.

reauth_confirm.title: Authorize Netatmo again
reauth_confirm.description: Your Netatmo authorization has expired or been revoked. Reconnect the same account that owns this indoor unit.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to retrieve indoor units. Check your connection and retry. If rate limited, wait at least 10 minutes.
error.invalid_device: Select one of the listed indoor units.

abort.already_configured: This indoor unit is already configured.
abort.no_devices: No matching indoor units were found. Check the selected product type and Netatmo account.
abort.invalid_auth: Netatmo rejected authorization. Check the app permissions and reconnect.
abort.missing_credentials: Add Netatmo Indoor Climate application credentials first.
abort.oauth_error: Netatmo returned an invalid authorization token.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Generating the authorization URL timed out.

init.title: Indoor polling
init.description: 30-600 seconds. Faster polling does not increase the device's measurement/upload frequency. Other clients share Netatmo's API quota.

indoor_webhook.title: Indoor polling and webhooks
indoor_webhook.description:
Webhook callback: {webhook_url}

Keep this URL private. Signed events are logged; sensor readings still use polling. Subscription is attempted automatically on load. 30-600 seconds for polling.

error.invalid_interval: Enter an interval between 30 and 600 seconds.
